name: ChuShi Music API
author: ChuShi
description: ChuShi Music API (ASCII-only build): the single producer of playback truth for the ChuShi SMTC stack. Pure observation -- native engine events (PlayState/PlayProgress/Seek) + read-only dva store access + validated media element reads. NEVER patches prototypes, NEVER dispatches store actions, NEVER rewrites currentTime in loops (NetEase's own progress bar stays untouched and healthy). Pushes 1 Hz truth (songId/position/duration/playing/metadata) and full lyrics (eapi word-level yrc with self-contained fresh MD5+AES-128-ECB crypto, klyric/channel/direct fallbacks) to the SMTC engine. Executes overlay and page controls at the element level (play/pause/seek) or via NetEase's own visible buttons (next/prev), with honest seek verification acks. Works whether NetEase's built-in SMTC switch is ON or OFF. Pair with ChuShi SMTC Manager (same port).
